result.summary: Independently read test/specs/REQ-058.md and test/letflow/engine/lua_script_audit_test.exs (not TEST-DESIGNER's own claims). All 7 acceptance criteria (6 original from docs/requirements.yaml AC list + AC7/INV-LSA-6 missing-prefix fail-closed added during elixir-dev rework1) each have >=1 runnable test: AC1 -> describe 'migration applies to a provisioned tenant schema' (4 tests), AC2 -> describe 'execute_script_for_audit/6 success path', AC3 -> describe 'instance_id validated before executor invocation' (3 tests incl. raise-if-called + Agent/send call-recorder), AC4 -> describe 'manifest hash mismatch', AC5/AC6 -> describe 'mix.exs and moduledoc guardrails' (3 tests), AC7 -> describe 'missing or blank :prefix fails closed' (4 tests). No @tag :skip anywhere in the file (grep confirmed zero matches), no 'TODO' in the spec or test file. Fixtures use per-test unique data (Ecto.UUID.generate() per test, tenant slug via System.unique_integer/1 in insert_tenant!/0) with no shared hardcoded IDs; each test independently provisions its own tenant via provisioned_tenant/0 and drops its own schema in on_exit/1, so tests are self-sufficient and don't depend on execution order (async: false is for the sandbox :auto-mode switch, not inter-test dependency). Grepped for password/secret/api_key/token/connection-string patterns: zero matches -- only fixture placeholder strings like 'sha256-fixture-hash'. Independently recomputed every describe+test combined name length myself (Python regex walk over the file, 'test ' prefix + describe + separator space + test name, matching ExUnit's actual combined-name construction) rather than trusting the spec's claim: 16 test cases total across 7 describe blocks, max combined length 134 chars (describe 'a malformed (non-UUID) instance_id is rejected...' pairing), all comfortably under both the 200-char target and the 255-char ExUnit/DB-identifier hard limit.
